text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen—a race to determine the 
true pinnacle!! A "dream" race where 
everyone running in the same era gathers, 
and I'm gonna dive right in too, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
There're so many awesome rivals here!! 
This is definitely gonna be an awesome 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And now, Yaeno and I are each other's 
"strongest opponent" and "best rival"!! 
We're gonna make our "dream" come true 
right now!
